crystals.name: Grandmaster Crystal
crystals.tip: Not worth buying for units. Save units for masteries.

crystals.name: Premium Hero Crystal
crystals.description: Slightly better than Grandmaster. Still mostly 3-star and 4-star champions.
crystals.tip: Same as Grandmaster — avoid spending units here.

crystals.name: Cavalier Crystal
crystals.description: Unlocked after reaching Cavalier. Drops 5-star, 6-star, and rarely 7-star champions.
crystals.tip: Decent value for early Cavaliers. Stop buying once you have a solid 6-star roster.

crystals.name: Paragon Crystal
crystals.description: Unlocked at Paragon. Guaranteed 6-star or 7-star champion.
crystals.tip: Best value unit crystal for endgame players.

crystals.name: Titan Crystal
crystals.description: Class-specific crystal. Higher chance at featured champs.
crystals.tip: Best value by far if you need a specific class champ.

crystals.name: Nexus Crystal
crystals.description: Pick 1 of 3 champions. Available in various rarities.
crystals.tip: Always buy nexus over basic if you can. Choice is powerful.

crystals.name: Dual Class Crystal
crystals.description: Two classes combined. Improves odds for your target class.

crystals.name: Featured 6-Star Crystal
crystals.description: Contains the monthly featured champion at increased odds.
crystals.tip: Only open if you want the featured champ. Otherwise use basic.

crystals.name: Basic 6-Star Crystal
crystals.description: Random 6-star champion from the basic pool.
crystals.tip: Best way to build your 6-star roster.

crystals.name: Basic 7-Star Crystal
crystals.description: Random 7-star champion from the basic pool.
crystals.tip: The ultimate endgame grind. Always worth opening.

offers.name: Daily Unit Bundle
offers.notes: Best value small purchase. Buy daily if you spend.

offers.name: Summoner Sigil Subscription
offers.contents: Bonus daily calendar, store access, 10% unit bonus on purchases, mastery reset access
offers.notes: Best value subscription in the game. The mastery reset alone is worth it.

offers.name: Weekly Unit Bundle
offers.notes: OK value if you need units quickly. Sigil is better.

offers.name: Rank-Up Gem Bundle
offers.notes: Only available through events. Buy immediately.

offers.name: Fresh Start Bundle
offers.notes: Great value for new players. One-time purchase.

offers.name: Revive Bundle
offers.notes: Revives are better earned or bought with units.

offers.name: Mastery Core Bundle
offers.contents: 5x Stony Core + 3x Carb Core + 1x Stone Core
offers.notes: Only available occasionally. Best value for mastery progression.

offers.name: Cyber Weekend Deal
offers.contents: Premium hero crystal, unit packs, 6-star shards, rank-up gems
offers.notes: Best yearly deal. Buy if you spend at all.

offers.name: 4th of July Deal
offers.contents: Premium hero crystal, unit packs, 6-star shards, rank-up gems
offers.notes: Second best yearly deal after Cyber Weekend.

spendingPriority.description: Carb Cores (x10), Stony Cores (x3), Stone Cores (x1)
spendingPriority.notes: Masteries are permanent. Invest here first.

spendingPriority.description: Energy refills for event completion and grinding
spendingPriority.notes: Spend energy on completion rather than exploration at first.

spendingPriority.description: Mastery resets and tweaks for different content
spendingPriority.notes: Sigil gives free weekly reset. Worth the subscription.
Best bang for buck. Bonuses stack up over time.
Better than basic. Only buy when you need roster expansion.
Good value for endgame. Skip if still building masteries.
OK value. Only worth for specific needs.
Poor value. Avoid spending units here.
Buy only when stuck on hard content. Not a regular purchase.
Lowest priority. The chase is expensive and unreliable.
